title: Sparse sensing 的 full-field reconstruction 與 uncertainty
statement: 由稀疏sensor重建temperature/strain/flow等full field時，如何同時得到校準uncertainty並辨識不可觀測區域。
known_result: 2026 GIS digital-twin研究用latent-space enhancement做稀疏temperature field reconstruction與uncertainty-aware sensing。
open_gap: sensor placement、distribution shift、model-form error與epistemic/aleatoric uncertainty分離。
first_task: 用2D heat equation建立known-truth field，隨機/optimized sparse sensors對比；故意移除關鍵區sensor。
validation_limits: synthetic PDE performance不代表真設備；uncertainty需對真誤差校準。
completion_criterion: 在held-out boundary/source conditions保持coverage，並能標示不可識別區域。
screening_note: 2026-09-28 初始有界文獻篩查。每輪重新查最新版本、實驗條件與失敗案例；simulation成果不得寫成已安全部署。
screening_queries: sparse sensing full field reconstruction digital twin uncertainty 2026

sources.title: Uncertainty-aware temperature field reconstruction from sparse samples and sensing via latent-space enhancement for GIS digital twin applications
